svg.title: How the auth method readiness groups are used
svg.desc: The telephony-only group is the include target of the registration campaign and the non-human accounts exclusion group is its exclude target, so real people are nudged to set up a passkey or Microsoft Authenticator and the group shrinks each run. The phishing-resistant and strong groups are nested in the System Preferred MFA Users parent group, the single include group for system-preferred authentication. No-method users are onboarded and review users are triaged by a person.
